}

function iceBeam19(ctx,fx,now,e){
 const [t,a]=hitAlpha(fx,now), sc=scaleFor(e), from=fx.from,to=fx.to, dx=to[0]-from[0], dy=to[1]-from[1], ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
 for(let i=0;i<13;i++){
   const q=CL((t-i*.045)/.72); if(q<=0) continue; const p=EZ(q), pt=MIX(from,to,p), size=(18+i%3*5)*sc;
   v353Draw(ctx,'ice'+(i%5),pt[0],pt[1],size,size,ang+i*.15,a*(.82-i*.04));
   if(i%2===0) shard(ctx,pt[0],pt[1],5*sc+i%2,ang+i*.4,'#d8f6ff',a*.55);
 }
 if(t>.56){
   const p=CL((t-.56)/.44);
   for(let i=0;i<9;i++){
     const theta=i*(Math.PI*2/9)+now*.008, rr=(8+p*(14+(i%3)*5))*sc;
     shard(ctx,to[0]+Math.cos(theta)*rr,to[1]+Math.sin(theta)*rr*.7,5*sc,theta,'#b8ecff',a*(.72-i*.05));
   }
 }
 return true;
}

function blizzard19(ctx,fx,now,e){
 const [t,a]=hitAlpha(fx,now), sc=scaleFor(e), to=fx.to;
 for(let i=0;i<20;i++){
   const q=CL((t-i*.02)/.88), x=to[0]-80*sc+q*160*sc+Math.sin(i+now*.01)*8*sc, y=to[1]-50*sc+(i%5)*18*sc+Math.cos(i+now*.013)*10*sc;
   if(q>0){
     v353Draw(ctx,'ice'+(i%5),x,y,(12+i%3*4)*sc,(12+i%3*4)*sc,now*.01+i,a*(.56-i*.018));
     if(i%3===0) circle(ctx,x,y,(2+i%2)*sc,'#f4ffff',a*.42);
   }
 }
 if(t>.60) for(let i=0;i<7;i++) ring(ctx,to[0],to[1],(14+i*7+(t-.60)*18)*sc,'#d7f6ff',1.8,a*(.40-i*.04),.82);
 return true;
}

function solarBeam19(ctx,fx,now,e){
 const [t,a]=hitAlpha(fx,now), sc=scaleFor(e), from=fx.from,to=fx.to;
 if(t<.34){
   const p=t/.34;
   for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
     const ang=i*(Math.PI*2/8)+now*.007, rr=(20+(1-p)*14)*sc;
     v353Draw(ctx,'energy'+(i%7),from[0]+Math.cos(ang)*rr,from[1]+Math.sin(ang)*rr*.7,14*sc,14*sc,ang,a*.72);
   }
   ring(ctx,from[0],from[1],(18+p*12)*sc,'#ffe96b',2.4,a*.62,.70);
   return true;
 }
 const p=EZ(CL((t-.28)/.72));
 v353Bezier(ctx,from,to,0,'#ffef77',14*sc,a*.55);
 v353Bezier(ctx,from,to,0,'#fffbd8',6*sc,a*.95);
 for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
   const q=CL((p-i*.05)); const pt=MIX(from,to,q);
   v353Draw(ctx,'energy'+(i%7),pt[0],pt[1],16*sc+q*10*sc,16*sc+q*10*sc,0,a*(.78-i*.05));
 }
 if(t>.62) v353Draw(ctx,'flash',to[0],to[1],42*sc,28*sc,0,a*.45);
 return true;
}

function sludgeBomb19(ctx,fx,now,e){
 const [t,a]=hitAlpha(fx,now), sc=scaleFor(e), from=fx.from,to=fx.to;
 const dx=to[0]-from[0], dy=to[1]-from[1], len=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy)), nx=-dy/len, ny=dx/len;
 const p=EZ(CL((t-.04)/.58));
 const x=L(from[0],to[0],p), y=L(from[1],to[1],p)-Math.sin(Math.PI*p)*20*sc;
 // projétil roxo MUITO visível
 dot(ctx,x,y,16*sc,'#6f2b89',a*.96);
 dot(ctx,x+2*sc,y-2*sc,10*sc,'#d791ff',a*.64);
 for(let i=8;i>=0;i--){
   const q=CL(p-i*.06); const tx=L(from[0],to[0],q), ty=L(from[1],to[1],q)-Math.sin(Math.PI*q)*(12-i)*sc;
   const wob=Math.sin(now*.012+i*1.4)*(5+i*.45)*sc;
   dot(ctx,tx+nx*wob,ty+ny*wob*.45,(4+i*.8)*sc,i%2?'#c878f0':'#8f44b2',a*(.10+i*.07));
 }
 // explosão tóxica bem grande no alvo
 if(t>.40){
   const hit=CL((t-.40)/.60);
   puff(ctx,to[0],to[1]-2*sc,(24+hit*14)*sc,'#7e329d',a*.42);
   puff(ctx,to[0]-12*sc,to[1]+2*sc,(16+hit*10)*sc,'#5d1f6f',a*.34);
   puff(ctx,to[0]+14*sc,to[1]-6*sc,(14+hit*10)*sc,'#b56fe0',a*.30);
   for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
     const ang=i*(Math.PI*2/14)+now*.006, rr=(10+hit*(18+(i%3)*6))*sc;
     dot(ctx,to[0]+Math.cos(ang)*rr,to[1]-4*sc+Math.sin(ang)*rr*.55,5+(i%2)*2,'#cf8eff',a*(.50-i*.022));
   }
   for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
     const rise=CL(hit-i*.06); if(rise<=0) continue;
     dot(ctx,to[0]-12*sc+i*4.5*sc,to[1]+10*sc-rise*(24+i*4)*sc,4+(i%2),'#e3b9ff',a*(.34-i*.03));
   }
   ring(ctx,to[0],to[1],16*sc+hit*12*sc,'#e0a4ff',2.1,a*.28,.72);
  }
 return true;
}


function razorLeaf19(ctx,fx,now,e){
 const [t,a]=hitAlpha(fx,now), sc=scaleFor(e), from=fx.from,to=fx.to, dx=to[0]-from[0], dy=to[1]-from[1], ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx), len=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy)), nx=-dy/len, ny=dx/len;

}

window.PokemonTorreV360Paint=function(ctx,fx,now,e){
 try{
   if(!fx||!fx.kind) return typeof prevPaint3519==='function'?prevPaint3519(ctx,fx,now,e):false;
   v3520Stats.fx[fx.kind]=(v3520Stats.fx[fx.kind]||0)+1;
   const nm=NM((fx.move&&fx.move.name)||fx.name||'');
   // Preserve what the user approved: surf, water pulse, bubble beam, waterfall, shadow ball, flamethrower,
   // petal dance, fire blast, earthquake. Only Hydro Pump gets an upgrade.
   if(fx.kind==='hydropump' || /hydropump|hidrobomba|hidrocanhao/.test(nm)) return hydroStrong(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='bonemerang' || /bonemerang|ossobumerangue|osso bumerangue/.test(nm)) return (typeof drawBoneExclusive==='function'?drawBoneExclusive(ctx,{...fx,kind:'bonemerang'},now):false) || true;
   if(fx.kind==='boneclub' || /boneclub|clubdeosso|porretedeosso/.test(nm)) return (typeof drawBoneExclusive==='function'?drawBoneExclusive(ctx,{...fx,kind:'boneclub'},now):boneClub19(ctx,fx,now,e)) || true;
   if(fx.kind==='mud') return mud19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='earthpower') return earthPower19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='rockslide') return rockSlide19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='nightshade' || /nightshade|sombranoturna/.test(nm) || (/shadow/.test(nm) && !/shadowball|boladesombra/.test(nm))) return nightShade19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='psychic' || /confusion|confusao/.test(nm)) return psychic19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='icebeam') return iceBeam19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='blizzard') return blizzard19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='solarbeam') return solarBeam19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='sludgebomb') return sludgeBomb19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='razorleaf' || fx.kind==='vine') return razorLeaf19(ctx,fx,now,e);
 }catch(err){ console.error('V35.20 FX error', err); }
 return typeof prevPaint3519==='function'?prevPaint3519(ctx,fx,now,e):false;
};

/* V35.32 - BONEMERANG EMOJI: dedicated final render layer. Other moves untouched. */
(function(){
 'use strict';
 const moveNorm=v=>String(v||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');
 const isBone=fx=>!!fx&&(fx.kind==='bonemerang'||/bonemerang|ossobumerangue|ossobumerang/.test(moveNorm(fx.move?.name||fx.name)));
 // The original sprite/canvas pipelines overlap. For Bonemerang only,
 // prevent earlier versions from drawing an invisible/conflicting bone.
 const previousPainter=window.PokemonTorreV360Paint;
 window.PokemonTorreV360Paint=function(ctx,fx,now,e){
  if(isBone(fx))return true;
  return typeof previousPainter==='function'?previousPainter(ctx,fx,now,e):false;
 };
 const previousDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
 let boneFrames=0,lastX=0,lastY=0,lastT=0;
 BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
  previousDraw.call(this,now);
  if(!battle?.active||!this.ctx||!Array.isArray(this.v359Attacks))return;
  const ctx=this.ctx;
  const ts=Number.isFinite(now)?now:performance.now();
  for(const fx of this.v359Attacks){
   if(!isBone(fx)||fx.battle!==battle||!fx.from||!fx.to)continue;
   const duration=Math.max(1,fx.duration||((fx.end||ts)-(fx.at||ts))||1120);
   const t=(ts-fx.at)/duration;
   if(t<0||t>1)continue;
   let p=t<=.5?t/.5:(1-t)/.5;
   p=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,p));
   p=p*p*(3-2*p);
   const x=fx.from[0]+(fx.to[0]-fx.from[0])*p;
   const y=fx.from[1]+(fx.to[1]-fx.from[1])*p-Math.sin(Math.PI*p)*20;
   const fontSize=Math.max(16,Math.min(24,(this.h||360)*.058));
   ctx.save();
   ctx.translate(x,y);
   ctx.rotate((t<=.5?1:-1)*t*Math.PI*4);
   ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
   ctx.font=fontSize+'px "Noto Color Emoji","Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji",sans-serif';
   ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,(t+.03)*8,(1.03-t)*8);
   ctx.shadowColor='#fff0b2';ctx.shadowBlur=2;
   ctx.fillText('🦴',0,0);
   ctx.restore();
   boneFrames++; lastX=x;lastY=y;lastT=t;
  }
 };
 function showVersion(){
  const label=document.getElementById('v30VersionTag');
  if(label)label.textContent='V35.34 · 🦴 BONEMERANG MENOR';
  const home=document.getElementById('v3520VersionHome');
  if(home)home.textContent='V35.34';
  document.title='Pokémon Torre V35.34 — Bonemerang Menor 🦴';
 }
 const prevRender=render;
 render=function(){const out=prevRender.apply(this,arguments);showVersion();return out;};
 showVersion();
 window.PokemonTorreVersion='V35.34';
 window.PokemonTorreV3534Diagnostics=()=>({version:'35.34',bonemerangFrames:boneFrames,lastX,lastY,lastT,activeBonemerang:!!engine?.v359Attacks?.some(isBone),font:'smallest'});
})();


/* V35.35 - Afinidade de arena e indicador de ATK+ por clima. Isolado dos efeitos visuais de golpes. */
(function(){
 'use strict';
 const V='V35.35';
 const ARENA_ATTACK=0.12;
 const WEATHER_BONUSES={rain:{water:1.20},sun:{fire:1.20},sand:{rock:1.12,ground:1.12},storm:{electric:1.12},fog:{ghost:1.10,poison:1.10},snow:{ice:1.12},hail:{ice:1.12},volcano:{fire:1.20}};
 const TYPE_SYMBOL={water:'💧',fire:'🔥',electric:'⚡',grass:'🌿',ground:'⛰',rock:'🪨',poison:'☣',psychic:'🔮',ghost:'👻',ice:'❄',fighting:'🥊',flying:'🪶',dragon:'🐉',normal:'✦',bug:'🐛',dark:'🌑',steel:'⚙',fairy:'✨'};
 const keyName=s=>String(s||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');
 function gymType(){
  if(!battle?.active)return null;
  // O cenário é o tipo visual do ginásio em que a luta está acontecendo.
  const idx=Number.isInteger(battle.v359Gym)?battle.v359Gym:save.gym;
  return GYMS[Math.max(0,Math.min(GYMS.length-1,idx))]?.type||null;
 }
 function monHasType(mon,type){const data=mon&&D[mon.id];return !!type&&!!data&&(data.type===type||data.type2===type);}
 function terrainBonus(mon){return monHasType(mon,gymType())?ARENA_ATTACK:0;}
 function weatherDetail(mon){
  if(!battle?.active||!mon)return [];
  const code=String(battle.v32Weather||'clear').toLowerCase();
  const boosts=WEATHER_BONUSES[code];if(!boosts)return [];
  return Object.entries(boosts)
   .filter(([type,mult])=>monHasType(mon,type)&&mult>1)
   .map(([type,mult])=>({type,amount:Math.round((mult-1)*100),name:TYPE_NAME[type]||type,icon:TYPE_SYMBOL[type]||'✦',weather:code}));
 }
 const V3548_BONUS_STATE={ally:{until:0,lines:[]},enemy:{until:0,lines:[]},bottomUntil:0,bottomText:''};
 function v3548MarkBonus(attacker){
  if(!battle?.active||!attacker)return;
  const terrain=terrainBonus(attacker),weather=weatherDetail(attacker);
  const lines=[];
  if(terrain)lines.push({text:'ATK +12% · ARENA',color:'#a8f5c4'});
  if(weather.length){const main=weather[0];lines.push({text:'ATK +'+main.amount+'% · '+main.icon+' '+String(main.name||'').toUpperCase(),color:'#ffe29e'});}
  if(!lines.length)return;
  const side=(attacker===current()||attacker===battle?.v31Duo?.ally)?'ally':'enemy';
  const until=performance.now()+1150;
  V3548_BONUS_STATE[side]={until,lines};
  if(side==='ally'){V3548_BONUS_STATE.bottomUntil=until;V3548_BONUS_STATE.bottomText=lines.map(l=>l.text).join(' · ');}
 }
 const previousDamage3535=damage;
 damage=function(attacker,defender,type,power){
  const result=previousDamage3535(attacker,defender,type,power);
  if(!result||!result.hit||!battle?.active||!attacker)return result;
  const bonus=terrainBonus(attacker);
  if(bonus)result.hit=Math.max(1,Math.round(result.hit*(1+bonus)));
  v3548MarkBonus(attacker);
  return result;
 };
 function statsFor(mon){return {arena:gymType(),terrain:terrainBonus(mon),weather:weatherDetail(mon),weatherCode:battle?.v32Weather||'clear',type:D[mon?.id]?.type||''};}
 const prevDraw3535=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
 function paintBuff(ctx,x,y,text,color){
  ctx.save();
  const fontSize=Math.max(7,Math.min(9,(engine?.h||360)*.019));
  ctx.font='800 '+fontSize+'px system-ui, sans-serif';
  const textWidth=ctx.measureText(text).width;
  const w=textWidth+10,h=fontSize+5;
  const xx=Math.max(w/2+3,Math.min((engine?.w||9999)-w/2-3,x));
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(6,21,30,0.87)';
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(158,214,191,0.65)';
  ctx.lineWidth=.8;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(xx-w/2,y-h/2,w,h,4);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillText(text,xx,y+0.5);
  ctx.restore();
 }
 function drawIndicators(e){
  if(!battle?.active||!e.ctx)return;
  const ctx=e.ctx,now=performance.now();
  const actors={ally:e.player,enemy:e.enemy};
  for(const side of ['ally','enemy']){
   const state=V3548_BONUS_STATE[side],pos=actors[side];
   if(!state||!pos||now>state.until||!state.lines?.length)continue;
   const x=pos.x,top=Math.max(28,pos.y-e.h*.205);
   state.lines.forEach((line,i)=>paintBuff(ctx,x,top+(i*14),line.text,line.color));

  const ret=prevDraw3535.call(this,now);

 // Rain Dance/Sunny Day/Sandstorm already change v32Weather in the combat engine.

  const labels={rain:'🌧 Chuva',sun:'☀ Sol forte',sand:'🌪 Areia',storm:'⛈ Tempestade',fog:'🌫 Névoa',snow:'❄ Neve',hail:'🌨 Granizo',volcano:'🌋 Calor vulcânico'};
  chip.textContent=labels[code]||code.toUpperCase();

/* V35.38 - flying refinement + smaller ATK labels. Baseline V35.35 protected. */
(function(){

const normalize=v=>String(v||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');
function flyingKind(s){

const v3545Time=(fx,now)=>{const duration=Math.max(1,fx.duration||fx.end-fx.at||800),t=v3545Clamp((now-fx.at)/duration);return [t,v3545Clamp(Math.min(t*8,(1-t)*8))];};
const v3545Scale=e=>Math.max(.8,Math.min(1.2,(e?.h||360)/480));
function v3545Line(ctx,pts,c,w,a){ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle=c;ctx.lineWidth=w;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.globalAlpha=v3545Clamp(a);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);for(const p of pts.slice(1))ctx.lineTo(p[0],p[1]);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();}
function v3545Oval(ctx,x,y,rx,ry,color,w,a){ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=w;ctx.globalAlpha=v3545Clamp(a);ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,Math.max(1,rx),Math.max(1,ry),0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();}
function v3545Chip(ctx,x,y,r,rot,a,color){ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=v3545Clamp(a);ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(rot);ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.strokeStyle='#e0bb86';ctx.lineWidth=.65;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-r,-r*.5);ctx.lineTo(-r*.3,-r);ctx.lineTo(r*.8,-r*.7);ctx.lineTo(r,r*.5);ctx.lineTo(-r*.2,r);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();}
// Module placeholders replaced in build
function v3545Earthquake(ctx,fx,now,e){
 const [t,a]=v3545Time(fx,now), sc=v3545Scale(e);
 const from=fx.from||[0,0],to=fx.to||from;
 const cx=(from[0]+to[0])/2,cy=(from[1]+to[1])/2+e.h*.032, p=v3545Ease(t);
 // Tremor de área, com rachaduras ramificadas e ondas se propagando pelo piso.
 for(let j=0;j<5;j++){
  const rr=(20+j*13+p*(62+j*9))*sc;
  v3545Oval(ctx,cx,cy,rr,rr*.55,j%2?'#edce97':'#9f7949',2.4,a*(.42-j*.058));
 }
 for(let j=0;j<12;j++){
  const ang=j*Math.PI*2/12+.14*Math.sin(now*.006+j),rr=(22+p*(58+(j%3)*18))*sc;
  const ox=cx+Math.cos(ang)*rr*.21,oy=cy+Math.sin(ang)*rr*.11;
  const mx=cx+Math.cos(ang)*rr*.66, my=cy+Math.sin(ang)*rr*.40;
  const ex=cx+Math.cos(ang)*rr,ey=cy+Math.sin(ang)*rr*.58;
  v3545Line(ctx,[[ox,oy],[mx+Math.sin(j*3)*8*sc,my],[ex,ey]],j%2?'#e4c58d':'#4a3025',2.5*sc,a*.68);
  if(j%2===0)v3545Line(ctx,[[mx,my],[mx+Math.cos(ang+.6)*24*sc,my+Math.sin(ang+.6)*14*sc]],'#cbab77',1.5*sc,a*.5);
 }
 for(let j=0;j<17;j++){
   const ang=j*2.399+now*.0016,rr=(12+p*(28+j%5*9))*sc;
   const x=cx+Math.cos(ang)*rr,y=cy+Math.sin(ang)*rr*.56-Math.sin(Math.PI*t)*(7+j%3*2)*sc;
   v3545Chip(ctx,x,y,2.3+(j%3)*1.0,ang,a*(.55-j*.017),'#95714b');
 }
}

function v3545Abalo(ctx,fx,now,e){
 const [t,a]=v3545Time(fx,now),sc=v3545Scale(e);
 const from=fx.from||[0,0],to=fx.to||from;
 const dx=to[0]-from[0],dy=to[1]-from[1],len=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy)),ux=dx/len,uy=dy/len,nx=-uy,ny=ux;
 const p=v3545Ease(Math.min(1,t/.72));
 const pts=[];
 for(let i=0;i<=10;i++){
   const q=(i/10)*p;
   const bx=from[0]+dx*q, by=from[1]+dy*q;
   const zig=((i%2)?1:-1)*(4+8*q)*sc + Math.sin(now*.008+i*.6)*2.2*sc;
   pts.push([bx+nx*zig, by+ny*zig*.42]);
 }
 v3545Line(ctx,pts,'#40281b',6.8*sc,a*.95);
 v3545Line(ctx,pts,'#c59a64',2.2*sc,a*.70);
 for(let i=1;i<pts.length-1;i++){
   const x=pts[i][0], y=pts[i][1], dir=(i%2)?1:-1;
   const l=(7+(i%3)*4+p*8)*sc;
   v3545Line(ctx,[[x,y],[x+nx*l*dir,y+ny*l*.7*dir]], i%2?'#5a3927':'#dfb985', i%2?2.3*sc:1.2*sc, a*(.55-i*.03));
   if(i%2===0) v3545Chip(ctx,x+nx*l*dir,y+ny*l*.7*dir,3.4*sc,.3+i,a*.44,'#8c6540');
 }
 for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
   const q=Math.max(0,p-i*.06); if(q<=0) continue;
   const bx=from[0]+dx*q, by=from[1]+dy*q;
   const off=((i%2)?1:-1)*(10+(i%4)*4)*sc;
   const lift=Math.sin(Math.PI*q)*(10+(i%3)*4)*sc;
   v3545Chip(ctx,bx+nx*off,by+ny*off*.25-lift,2.8+(i%3)*.8,.2+i,a*(.42-i*.015),i%2?'#bc9261':'#6f5035');
 }
 if(t>.42){
   const q=v3545Ease((t-.42)/.58),cx=to[0],cy=to[1]+3*sc;
   v3545Oval(ctx,cx,cy,(18+q*34)*sc,(9+q*16)*sc,'#f0cf9c',2.6,a*.62);
   for(let i=0;i<12;i++){
     const ang=i*Math.PI*2/12+now*.003,rr=(10+q*(18+(i%3)*6))*sc;
     const px=cx+Math.cos(ang)*rr, py=cy+Math.sin(ang)*rr*.54-q*(6+(i%2)*3)*sc;
     v3545Chip(ctx,px,py,2.8+(i%3)*.8,ang,a*(.58-i*.02),i%2?'#b88e5f':'#705034');
   }
   for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
     const off=(-2+i)*12*sc, h=(12+q*22+(i%2)*7)*sc;
     v3545Line(ctx,[[cx+off,cy+4*sc],[cx+off*1.02,cy-h],[cx+off+3*sc,cy+1*sc]],'#5c3d29',3.6*sc,a*.55);
     v3545Line(ctx,[[cx+off,cy+4*sc],[cx+off*1.02,cy-h],[cx+off+3*sc,cy+1*sc]],'#d3ae78',1.2*sc,a*.34);
   }
 }
}

function v3545Tremor(ctx,fx,now,e){
 const [t,a]=v3545Time(fx,now),sc=v3545Scale(e);
 const to=fx.to||[0,0],x=to[0],y=to[1]+6*sc;
 // Tremor localizado: pequenos pulsos circulares e seixos pulando no solo.
 for(let j=0;j<5;j++){
  const f=(t-j*.14);
  if(f<0||f>1)continue;
  const p=v3545Ease(f),r=(11+p*31)*sc;
  v3545Oval(ctx,x,y,r,r*.38,j%2?'#eed6a8':'#917252',2.0,a*(1-p)*.65);
 }
 for(let j=0;j<9;j++){
  const f=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(t-j*.065)*1.5));if(!f)continue;
  const th=j*2.399,r=(7+(j%3)*8)*sc;
  const bx=x+Math.cos(th)*r,by=y+Math.sin(th)*r*.52-Math.sin(f*Math.PI)*12*sc;
  v3545Chip(ctx,bx,by,2.4+(j%3)*.75,th,a*(.4-j*.015),'#b49a73');
 }
}

const v3545PreviousPainter=window.PokemonTorreV360Paint;
let v3545Hits={earthquake:0,abalo:0,tremor:0};
window.PokemonTorreV360Paint=function(ctx,fx,now,e){
 if(fx?.from&&fx?.to){
   const name=v3545Normalize(fx.move?.name||fx.name);
   // Cada golpe usa desenho próprio, independente do kind genérico 'earthpower'.
   if(/earthquake|terremoto/.test(name)){v3545Earthquake(ctx,fx,now,e);v3545Hits.earthquake++;return true;}
   if(/abaloterrestre/.test(name)){v3545Abalo(ctx,fx,now,e);v3545Hits.abalo++;return true;}
   if(/tremor/.test(name)){v3545Tremor(ctx,fx,now,e);v3545Hits.tremor++;return true;}
 }
 return typeof v3545PreviousPainter==='function'?v3545PreviousPainter(ctx,fx,now,e):false;
};
// Earthquake é adicionado ao catálogo no bloco V34, onde v32Catalogue existe.
// Aplicar APENAS paleta de cores, por cima da cadeia existente de animação.
// Não substitui frames nem sprites Idle/Walk/Attack/Hurt/Faint.
const v3545OldDrawMon=BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon;
let v3545ShinyDraws=0;
const v3552SpriteBuffers=new WeakMap();
let v3552StarFrames=0, v3552TintFrames=0;
function v3552GetLayer(e){
  let l=v3552SpriteBuffers.get(e);
  if(!l){ const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=176;canvas.height=176;l={canvas,ctx:canvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true})};v3552SpriteBuffers.set(e,l); }
  return l;
}
function v3552Star(ctx,x,y,r,alpha,phase){
 ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,alpha));ctx.fillStyle='#ffe978';ctx.strokeStyle='#fff5b8';ctx.lineWidth=1;
 ctx.shadowColor='#ffdf67';ctx.shadowBlur=3;
 ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(phase);
 ctx.beginPath();
 for(let i=0;i<8;i++){const angle=i*Math.PI/4-Math.PI/2, radius=i%2===0?r:r*.35;const xx=Math.cos(angle)*radius,yy=Math.sin(angle)*radius;if(!i)ctx.moveTo(xx,yy);else ctx.lineTo(xx,yy);}
 ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
}
function v3555ShinyTones(id){
 switch(Number(id)){
  // Apenas source-atop para evitar qualquer halo/quadrado do canvas ao redor do sprite.
  case 18:return [['rgba(198,154,92,0.44)','source-atop'],['rgba(244,226,185,0.16)','source-atop']]; // Pidgeot shiny: dourado fiel e visível
  case 6:return [['rgba(63,68,74,0.44)','source-atop'],['rgba(115,214,194,0.10)','source-atop']]; // Charizard shiny escuro
  case 94:return [['rgba(146,156,214,0.28)','source-atop'],['rgba(236,223,255,0.10)','source-atop']]; // Gengar mais claro
  case 68:return [['rgba(150,190,124,0.28)','source-atop'],['rgba(228,244,214,0.10)','source-atop']]; // Machamp verde
  case 62:return [['rgba(89,98,186,0.30)','source-atop'],['rgba(198,219,255,0.08)','source-atop']]; // Poliwrath azul
  case 105:return [['rgba(132,181,101,0.30)','source-atop'],['rgba(232,225,182,0.09)','source-atop']]; // Marowak esverdeado
  default:return [['rgba(225,199,108,0.26)','source-atop'],['rgba(255,239,180,0.08)','source-atop']];
 }
}
function v3555ApplyShinyTint(ctx,w,h,id){
 const tones=v3555ShinyTones(id);
 for(const [fill,mode] of tones){ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation=mode||'source-atop';ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.restore();}
}
BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon=function(actor,id,isEnemy,now){
 const monRef=isEnemy?foe():current();
 if(!monRef?.shiny||monRef.id!==id||!this.ctx||!actor) return v3545OldDrawMon.call(this,actor,id,isEnemy,now);
 const main=this.ctx, layer=v3552GetLayer(this), ctx=layer.ctx;
 const bw=layer.canvas.width,bh=layer.canvas.height;
 ctx.save();ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,bw,bh);
 // Renderiza SOMENTE o Pokemon numa camada transparente: a arena nao pode ser tingida.
 ctx.translate(bw/2-actor.x,bh/2-actor.y);
 this.ctx=ctx;
 let result;
 try{result=v3545OldDrawMon.call(this,actor,id,isEnemy,now);}finally{this.ctx=main;ctx.restore();}
 v3555ApplyShinyTint(ctx,bw,bh,id);
 main.save();main.drawImage(layer.canvas,actor.x-bw/2,actor.y-bh/2);main.restore();
 v3552TintFrames++;
 // Estrelas vetoriais so na entrada, somem depois.
 if(battle?.active){
  const keyId=isEnemy?'v3552FoeId':'v3552AllyId';
  const keyTime=isEnemy?'v3552FoeUntil':'v3552AllyUntil';
  if(battle[keyId]!==monRef){battle[keyId]=monRef;battle[keyTime]=now+2200;}
  const rem=Math.max(0,(battle[keyTime]||0)-now);
  if(rem>0){
    const k=1-rem/2200,fade=Math.min(1,rem/330)*Math.min(1,(k+.04)*6);
    const r=(this.h||500)/500,spread=(13+9*Math.sin(k*Math.PI))*r;
    const xx=actor.x,yy=actor.y-(this.h||500)*.11;
    for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
      const a=i*Math.PI*2/7+now*.003,drift=spread*(.70+(i%3)*.12);
      v3552Star(main,xx+Math.cos(a)*drift,yy+Math.sin(a)*drift*.84, (i%3===0?5.5:3.7)*r,fade*(.55+(i%2)*.17),a+now*.003);
    }
    v3552StarFrames++;
  }
 }
 v3545ShinyDraws++;
 return result;
};

// V35.54: inimigos Lutador fisicos tambem so acertam corpo a corpo.
const v3554PreviousHit=BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget;
BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget=function(side,type,power){
  const rangedFighting=(side==='enemy'&&(this.v359Attacks||[]).some(fx=>fx.end>performance.now()&&fx.move?.type==='fighting'&&/aurasphere|esferaaura|focusblast|vacuumwave|ondadevacuo/.test(String(fx.move?.name||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,''))));
  if(type==='fighting'&&!rangedFighting&&battle?.active&&this.player&&this.enemy){
    const d=Math.hypot(this.player.x-this.enemy.x,this.player.y-this.enemy.y);
    if(d>Math.max(56,this.h*.19)){
      this.v3554Misses=(this.v3554Misses||0)+1;
      // Qualquer dano Lutador fora do alcance e ignorado; Aura Sphere e especial
      // sera tratado pelo sistema de golpes nomeados se presente.
      return;
    }
  }
  return v3554PreviousHit.call(this,side,type,power);
};
const v3554PreviousUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
  const enemyFighting=battle?.active&&D[foe()?.id]?.type==='fighting';
  const far=enemyFighting&&this.player&&this.enemy&&Math.hypot(this.player.x-this.enemy.x,this.player.y-this.enemy.y)>Math.max(56,this.h*.19);
  if(far){
    // Nao permite ataque remoto de IA para quem usa socos/chutes.
    if(this.telegraph?.from==='enemy'&&this.telegraph.type==='fighting')this.telegraph=null;
    if(Number.isFinite(this.enemyAttackCD))this.enemyAttackCD=Math.max(.24,this.enemyAttackCD);
  }
  const result=v3554PreviousUpdate.call(this,dt,now);
  if(far&&Array.isArray(this.projectiles))this.projectiles=this.projectiles.filter(x=>!(x.from==='enemy'&&x.type==='fighting'));
  return result;
};
window.PokemonTorreV3554Diagnostics=()=>({version:'35.57',starDurationMs:2200,shinyColor:'species-faithful-animated',meleeRangePx:Math.max(56,(engine?.h||720)*.19),outOfReach:engine?.v3554OutOfReach||0,misses:engine?.v3554Misses||0,allyShiny:!!current()?.shiny,starRemaining:Math.max(0,(battle?.v3552AllyUntil||0)-performance.now())});
window.PokemonTorreV3552Diagnostics=()=>({version:'35.52',tintedFrames:v3552TintFrames,starFrames:v3552StarFrames,allyShiny:!!current()?.shiny,starRemaining:Math.max(0,(battle?.v3552AllyUntil||0)-performance.now())});

const v3545OldRender=render;
function v3545Version(){
 const label=document.getElementById('v30VersionTag');if(label)label.textContent='V35.57 · SHINY FIEL SEM HALO';
 const home=document.getElementById('v3520VersionHome');if(home)home.textContent='V35.57';
 document.title='Pokémon Torre V35.57 — Shiny fiel sem halo';
}

v3545Version();window.PokemonTorreVersion='V35.57';
const v3548RenderPrev=renderBattle;
renderBattle=function(){
 const ret=v3548RenderPrev.apply(this,arguments);

 if(ally){ally.querySelectorAll('.v31Status').forEach(n=>n.remove()); if(current()?.shiny && !ally.querySelector('.v301ShinyFlag')) ally.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<span class="v301ShinyFlag">✦ SHINY</span>');}
 if(enemy){enemy.querySelectorAll('.v31Status').forEach(n=>n.remove()); if(foe()?.shiny && !enemy.querySelector('.v301ShinyFlag')) enemy.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<span class="v301ShinyFlag">✦ SHINY</span>');}
 return ret;
};
const v3548UpdateFastPrev=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
 const ret=v3548UpdateFastPrev.call(this,dt,now);
 if(battle?.active&&!battle.paused){
  if(Number.isFinite(this.enemyAttackCD))this.enemyAttackCD=Math.min(this.enemyAttackCD,1.18);
  const d=battle.v31Duo;
  if(d&&Number.isFinite(d.clockEnemy))d.clockEnemy=Math.min(d.clockEnemy,1.55);
 }
 return ret;
};
window.PokemonTorreV3545Diagnostics=()=>({version:'35.52',hitCounts:{...v3545Hits},shinyDraws:v3545ShinyDraws,shiny:!!current()?.shiny,marowakMoveList:'Earthquake disponível em catálogo V34'});
})();

/* INICIO 01_shiny_animado.js */
/* V35.58: sprites shiny por especie, sem filtros quadrados no canvas */
const SHINY_PROTEGIDO_SPRITES = {"18":{"Idle":"data:image/png;base64,","Walk":"data:image/png;base64,","Attack":"data:image/png;base64,","Hurt":"data:image/png;base64,","Portrait":"data:image/png;base64,"},"6":{"Idle":"data:image/png;base64,","Walk":"data:image/png;base64,","Attack":"data:image/png;base64,","Hurt":"data:image/png;base64,","Portrait":"data:image/png;base64,"},"94":{"Idle":"data:image/png;base64,","Walk":"data:image/png;base64,","Attack":"data:image/png;base64,","Hurt":"data:image/png;base64,","Portrait":"data:image/png;base64,"},"105":{"Idle":"data:image/png;base64,","Walk":"data:image/png;base64,","Attack":"data:image/png;base64,","Hurt":"data:image/png;base64,","Portrait":"data:image/png;base64,"},"62":{"Idle":"data:image/png;base64,","Walk":"data:image/png;base64,","Attack":"data:image/png;base64,","Hurt":"data:image/png;base64,","Portrait":"data:image/png;base64,"},"68":{"Idle":"data:image/png;base64,","Walk":"data:image/png;base64,","Attack":"data:image/png;base64,","Hurt":"data:image/png;base64,","Portrait":"data:image/png;base64,"}};

const shinySpriteCache = Object.create(null);
let shinyProtectedFrames=0,shinyProtectedStars=0;
const shinyActualFrames={Idle:0,Walk:0,Attack:0,Hurt:0};
function shinyProtectedImages(id){
 id=Number(id);
 if(!SHINY_PROTEGIDO_SPRITES[id])return null;
 if(shinySpriteCache[id])return shinySpriteCache[id];
 const out={};
 for(const action of ['Idle','Walk','Attack','Hurt']){
   const image=new Image();image.decoding='async';image.src=SHINY_PROTEGIDO_SPRITES[id][action];out[action]=image;
 }
 return (shinySpriteCache[id]=out);
}
const shinyPreviousDrawMon=BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon;
// Desenho independente para shiny; não há sobrescrita de sheets a cada frame.
// Assim garantimos que cada animação percorre seus próprios quadros e não volta ao Idle.
function shinyVectorStar(ctx,x,y,r,alpha,phase){
 ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,alpha));ctx.fillStyle='#ffe98b';
 ctx.strokeStyle='#fff9d6';ctx.lineWidth=.8;ctx.shadowColor='#ffe3a7';ctx.shadowBlur=2;
 ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(phase);ctx.beginPath();
 for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
   const a=i*Math.PI/4-Math.PI/2,rr=i%2===0?r:r*.36;
   const px=Math.cos(a)*rr,py=Math.sin(a)*rr;
   if(i===0)ctx.moveTo(px,py);else ctx.lineTo(px,py);
 }
 ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
}
function shinySelectAction(actor,e,isEnemy,id){
 if((actor.flash||0)>0)return 'Hurt';
 if((e.attackActs?.[isEnemy?'enemy':'player']||0)>e.time)return 'Attack';
 let vx=actor.x-(actor.v3559LastX??actor.x),vy=actor.y-(actor.v3559LastY??actor.y);
 const moving=Math.hypot(vx,vy)>.38 || (!isEnemy && Math.hypot(e.input?.dx||0,e.input?.dy||0)>.12);
 actor.v3559LastX=actor.x;actor.v3559LastY=actor.y;
 return moving?'Walk':'Idle';
}
function shinyBlitFrame(ctx,img,action,actor,foeActor,engine,now){
 const frames=Math.max(1,Math.floor(img.naturalWidth/img.naturalHeight));
 if(actor.v3559Action!==action || actor.v3559Species!==engine.v3559CurrentId){
   actor.v3559Action=action;
   actor.v3559Species=engine.v3559CurrentId;
   actor.v3559ActionAt=now;
 }
 const elapsed=Math.max(0,now-(actor.v3559ActionAt||now));
 const frameDuration=action==='Walk'?88:action==='Attack'?Math.max(28,460/frames):action==='Hurt'?115:130;
 const index=(action==='Idle'||action==='Walk')?
   Math.floor(elapsed/frameDuration)%frames:Math.min(frames-1,Math.floor(elapsed/frameDuration));
 // O retângulo é recortado APENAS dos pixels do quadro; fundo transparente intacto.
 let crop;
 if(typeof v19FrameBounds==='function')crop=v19FrameBounds(img,index*img.naturalHeight,0,img.naturalHeight,img.naturalHeight);
 else crop={x:index*img.naturalHeight,y:0,w:img.naturalHeight,h:img.naturalHeight};
 const height=(engine.h||600)*(engine.v3559EnemyFlag?.079:.084);
 const width=height*Math.min(1.45,crop.w/Math.max(1,crop.h));
 const target=foeActor||actor;
 const towardX=(target.x-actor.x)||1;
 const mirror=towardX<0;
 let dx=0,dy=0;
 const bob=Math.sin(now*.009)*((action==='Idle'?2.1:1.0)*(engine.h||600)/600);
